MacTahoe-gtk-theme — vendored snapshot for offline fallback

Upstream:  https://github.com/vinceliuice/MacTahoe-gtk-theme

Vendored:  2026-08-01 by Fedora MacTahoe Eprahemi

Purpose: if the upstream repo is ever unreachable (deleted, network
failure, GitHub outage), install.sh compiles the theme from THIS copy
instead of failing. GDM + Firefox theming use the vendored tweaks.sh.

Kept:      install.sh, tweaks.sh, parse-sass.sh, libs/, src/, other/, COPYING
Stripped:  .git, screenshots, wallpaper/, release/, build scripts, README
Re-vendor: clone upstream fresh, repeat the strip, update this file.
